title: Clamp public gallery limits like history
body:
## Summary
getPublicScanGallery does not coerce NaN the way history and comparison already do, so a NaN limit empties both rails.

## Description
src/lib/db/scans-read.ts clamps history and comparison with Math.max(1, Math.min(200, Math.trunc(n) || default)). The gallery uses Math.max(1, opts.recentLimit ?? 12) and the same for topLimit (src/lib/db/scans-read.ts:946). Math.max(1, NaN) is NaN, and a slice end of NaN is 0, so both rails come back empty while totalRepos can still be set. The SQL windows are already take GALLERY_CANDIDATE_CAP (200) at src/lib/db/scans-read.ts:894 and :900, so a huge finite limit does not enlarge the query. The only production caller, src/app/page.tsx:112, calls getPublicScanGallery() with no arguments.

## Flow
- Pass recentLimit: NaN (or topLimit: NaN) into getPublicScanGallery
- Math.max returns NaN and the rail slice is empty
- The landing page calls the function with no arguments, so this path is unreached in production

## Expected impact
A caller that passed NaN would get the same default rails history gets from a bad limit. Nothing on the landing page changes until a caller passes a limit. The query cap stays 200.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - gallery limits coerce like the other two readers
Before: 0 of 1 gallery limit pairs coerce NaN; history and comparison both do
After: not measured; the clamp was not edited
Method: simulation - walked Math.max(1, NaN) and the two call sites against the history clamp
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: src/lib/db/scans-read.ts:946 recentLimit/topLimit; :894 and :900 take GALLERY_CANDIDATE_CAP; src/lib/db/scans-read.ts:451 and :685 history/comparison clamps; src/app/page.tsx:112 getPublicScanGallery()
note: 0 production callers pass a limit; query already take 200; --ab was not passed

title: Trim both sides of joined repo names on signal reads
body:
## Summary
Platform-signal and unmeasurable-dimension lookups lowercase a joined fullName and do not trim each side of the slash.

## Description
canonicalRepoFullName (src/lib/db/scans-shared.ts:33) trims and lowercases owner and name separately. getLatestPlatformSignals (src/lib/db/scans-read.ts:990) and getLatestUnmeasurableDims (src/lib/db/scans-read.ts:1031) look up orgId_fullName with fullName.toLowerCase() only. The rescan route trims the whole string (src/app/api/org/local/rescan/route.ts:39) and does not split on the slash. No caller in this tree was shown sending a padded side. The two readers are outside a change to canonicalRepoFullName unless they call it.

## Flow
- A caller passes fullName "Acme/ Widget"
- toLowerCase yields "acme/ widget"
- The stored key from canonicalRepoFullName is "acme/widget", so the lookup misses

## Expected impact
A padded side would hit the same row the writer stored. Known callers trim the whole string or pass "o/r", so nobody on those paths notices today. A helper that splits and calls canonicalRepoFullName stays inside scans-read.ts.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - signal reads use the same repo key as the writer
Before: 2 of 2 joined-fullName lookups lowercase only; 0 padded-side callers proven
After: not measured; the lookups were not edited
Method: simulation - compared the two where-clauses with canonicalRepoFullName and the rescan trim
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: src/lib/db/scans-read.ts:990 and :1031 fullName.toLowerCase(); src/lib/db/scans-shared.ts:33 canonicalRepoFullName; src/app/api/org/local/rescan/route.ts:39 fullName.trim()
note: 0 padded-side callers proven; rescan trims the whole string only; --ab was not passed
